name: Dear world -Re.-
source:
Yuuki is a elementary school boy.
He plays all the time with his friends.
One day, a girl is moved to his neighborhood.
Her name is Lily.

He want to get close with her.
But how?
He tries to play with her!

[from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE048253.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
勇树是一名小学生。
他总是和朋友们一起玩。
一天，一名女孩搬到他家附近。
她叫莉莉。

他想和她亲近起来。
但该怎么做呢？
他试着邀请她一起玩！

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE048253.html]DLsite English[/url]]
